mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (openid, token, nick_no, total_count, today_count, last_study_date) VALUES (#{openid}, #{token}, #{nickNo}, 0, 0, #{lastStudyDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET token = #{token}, nick_no = #{nickNo}, total_count = #{totalCount}, today_count = #{todayCount}, last_study_date = #{lastStudyDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `user` WHERE total_count > 0 ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM `user` WHERE today_count > 0 AND last_study_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY today_count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM `user` WHERE total_count > (SELECT total_count FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId})
SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM `user` WHERE today_count > (SELECT today_count FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId}) AND last_study_date = CURDATE()

SELECT id, openid, token, nick_no, avatar, total_count, today_count, last_study_date, custom_total_count, custom_today_count, custom_last_study_date, create_time, update_time FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE `user` SET report_migrated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
